description: The native slicer makes the reader open a list to filter, and it always opens with nothing selected: every report starts on "all years" even when everyone wants this year. Buttons are faster, and a sensible starting point saves a click on every visit. Chip Slicer turns a field into a row of buttons — chips — that filter the page with one click. It is free for everyone, with every feature: no Pro tier, no licence, no watermark. WHAT IT ADDS TO A SLICER • Default selection: type "2026" or "Spain, France" and the report opens with them selected. If the reader clears it, it stays clear until the page is opened again. • Clear button (✕) and an optional "All" chip. • Counts on the chips: put a measure in Value and each chip shows its count or total, with your model's format. Items without a value are hidden. • Sort by data order, A to Z, Z to A or by value. • Horizontal, vertical or grid layout, with automatic or fixed columns, one scrolling row, stretch to fill and alignment. Long labels end with "…". • Six style templates — Classic, Outline, Soft, Square, Segmented, Dark — plus colors, font, check mark and shadow. • Optional header. WORKS LIKE A NATIVE SLICER • A standard Power BI filter: sync slicers, bookmarks, edit interactions and the filter pane all work. • Single or multi-select; Ctrl+click adds. • Text, numbers, dates and hierarchy levels; codes keep their leading zeros. •…
